news_codex_ratings.json.review_mode: Scheduled cloud dual-review; independent Codex desk
limitations: Confidence values are subjective evidence confidence, not return probabilities. News remains unweighted in the trading score.

Only material new or materially changed evidence is newly reviewed in this run. Still-valid current-session ATRL, FFL, upstream and Oil Marketing ratings are carried forward unchanged so the desk file does not erase valid current-session context.
PIBTL's FY26 article was fully accessible and was published at 3:43 PM PKT on September 21, after Monday's 3:30 PM close, so it belongs to Tuesday's session and is newly added.

The Business Recorder FCCL article was not directly accessible in this cloud session. The committed raw feed contains a substantive headline and snippet plus a 1:26 PM PKT publication timestamp; it is therefore labelled headline-only and confidence is limited.

Fast Cables' full Mettis article is now accessible, but it was published at 12:31 PM PKT on September 21 inside the prior session and already has story history, so it is not republished as Tuesday-session evidence.
The latest raw refresh added a Gaza diplomacy headline with no traceable company or configured sector cash-flow linkage for the tracked universe; it is not turned into a rating.

reviewed_stories.title: PIBTL rebounds to Rs3.4bn profit in FY26
reviewed_stories.linkage_detail: Direct earnings event for Pakistan International Bulk Terminal Limited (PSX: PIBTL), whose identity and FY26 figures are verified on the official PSX company page.
reviewed_stories.reason: FY26 net profit reached Rs3.37bn versus a Rs257.93m loss in FY25. Revenue rose 64%, gross profit rose 165% and finance cost fell 43%, establishing a material direct improvement in reported earnings.
reviewed_stories.publication_time_status: Mettis Global article page states September 21, 2026 at 03:43 PM GMT+05:00. That is after Monday's 03:30 PM PSX close, so the story belongs to Tuesday's session.

reviewed_stories.title: Fauji Cement to install battery storage, solar power at two plants
reviewed_stories.linkage_detail: Direct project approval for Fauji Cement Company Limited (PSX: FCCL), whose identity is verified on the official PSX company page.
reviewed_stories.reason: The committed Business Recorder headline and snippet state that FCCL's board approved 50 MWh of battery energy storage and 10 MW of dedicated solar at two plants. This is directionally positive through lower grid-energy exposure and better reliability, but no accessible body disclosed capex, commissioning timing or quantified savings.
reviewed_stories.publication_time_status: The committed raw feed records September 22, 2026 at 01:26:05 PM PKT. The linked Business Recorder page was not directly accessible in this cloud session, so the timestamp and evidence remain headline/snippet-level rather than page-verified.

ATRL.reason: Intermarket Securities' full ATRL initiation points to higher utilization, stronger product yields and brownfield-upgrade economics, but the upside is forecast- and execution-dependent rather than a new operating disclosure.
ATRL.relevance: Direct link: Attock Refinery Limited (ATRL), verified as a PSX-listed refinery.

FFL.reason: The CEO resignation is a direct governance event, but the verified evidence discloses no earnings, cash-flow, ownership or strategic effect; the successor is still to be appointed.
FFL.relevance: Direct link: Fauji Foods Limited (PSX: FFL), verified on the official PSX company page.

OGDC.reason: Brent remains around $100-$102 amid the conflict, but the latest bounce is described as short covering while Saudi export recovery and possible US-Iran talks keep the upstream tailwind weak.
OGDC.relevance: Sector link: Oil & Gas Exploration; OGDC directly sells produced hydrocarbons.

PPL.reason: Brent remains around $100-$102 amid the conflict, but the latest bounce is described as short covering while Saudi export recovery and possible US-Iran talks keep the upstream tailwind weak.
PPL.relevance: Sector link: Oil & Gas Exploration; PPL directly sells produced hydrocarbons.

MARI.reason: The conflict still supports hydrocarbon pricing, but the latest crude bounce is not presented as a fundamental reversal and recovering Saudi flows keep the crude-price tailwind weak. Confidence stays lower because crude is only part of MARI's hydrocarbon exposure.
MARI.relevance: Sector link: Oil & Gas Exploration; MARI produces and sells hydrocarbons.

PIBTL.reason: FY26 swung to Rs3.37bn net profit from a Rs257.93m loss as revenue rose 64%, gross profit rose 165% and finance cost fell 43%, a direct earnings improvement.
PIBTL.relevance: Direct link: Pakistan International Bulk Terminal Limited (PSX: PIBTL), verified on the official PSX company page.

FCCL.reason: The board approved 50 MWh of battery storage plus 10 MW of dedicated solar at two plants, directionally reducing grid-energy exposure and supporting reliability, but accessible evidence does not disclose capex, commissioning timing or quantified savings.
FCCL.relevance: Direct link: Fauji Cement Company Limited (PSX: FCCL), verified on the official PSX company page.

Oil Marketing.reason: Today's petrol/HSD reset changes import and retail prices, but the OMC profit margin remains fixed at Rs7.87/litre, so the reset itself is neutral for OMC unit margins.
Oil Marketing.relevance: Sector link: Oil Marketing, including PSO.
